conditions.gpu: disabled; software raster and readback included
conditions.workload: Constant-population timings disable knockback in both sources and suppress autonomous specials; subsequent stress checks restore full knockback and specials.

pixelChecks: opaque native last pixel of both captures
lightning crosses the top pixel rows of both captures and reaches the target
beam reaches left and right portrait borders
flash covers the first and last portrait rows
confetti appears near top and bottom independently of world camera
scene changes refresh the bounded background cache
flash does not remain in a reused background

cache.backgrounds: One native layer per live context, replaced on scene or size change.

balanceRegression.comparison: Complete winner, duration, eliminations and per-fighter telemetry exactly reproduce the measured v0.8 results. Drawing no longer consumes combat randomness for lightning.

limitations: Headless Chromium used software rendering and pixel readback; timings are not OBS or user-PC FPS.
TikTok was simulated; no real LIVE was connected.
Native canvas resolution does not automatically change OBS output settings.
